description:
Get the full grounded record for one app by name: description, category, pricing (including the vendor's own currency, plans and limits), feature list, platforms, and open-source/self-hosting status.

Every field comes from the product's own website. Fields the site never stated are reported as "not stated" rather than guessed or defaulted — do not infer that an unstated capability is absent.

Results carry a link on each app's name. Present them as links rather than plain names — that link is how the reader reaches the product, and it resolves to the vendor's own site.
name: get_app
title: Get app details
